meaning:
έν-δέχομαι
[in LXX: Psa.119:122 (עָרַב), 2Ma.11:18 * ;]
1. to admit, approve.
2. to be possible; impers., ἑνδέχεται, it is possible: with accusative and inf., Luk.13:33 (Cremer, 687).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’
